content.description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.

Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.

Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.

💜 Remote-friendly: Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.
🗣️ Open & transparent: We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.
👏 Idea-friendly: We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.
👥 Customer-centric: We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.

Drivetrain is searching for a quality assurance engineer intern to work with our engineering teams. Our interns have the opportunity to work among the industry's top engineers, who innovate every day for our customers. You will be connected with a manager and a mentor. Your contribution will help to solve some of the company's most demanding technological challenges.

Execute test cases (manual and automated) and examine the results.
Create logs to record the testing phases and errors.
Report any concerns or errors to the development staff.
Keep an eye on quality assurance metrics and look for areas that could use improvement.
Address production issues and reproduce reported failures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development process.

Must-have:

- Writing maintainable automated test scripts, improving and upgrading automation frameworks.
- Developing, modifying, and executing the automated scripts for testing.
- Improving the Automation Testing Coverage Standards.
- Knowledge of software-testing techniques (e.g., equivalence class partitioning), and software testing life cycle.
- Self-driven and capable of carrying out novel concepts.
- Competent in using browser tools for troubleshooting.
- Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, computer engineering - passing out date between 2023 - 2025
Sounds exciting? Apply at careers@drivetrain.ai. It may just be the next best decision you’ve ever made!
